display.purpose: The 'Sanj's Planner' wordmark only. Never reused elsewhere.

headline.purpose: Section titles: dashboard greeting, modal titles, tab-panel headings.

body.purpose: Default running text, subtitles, form values.

label.purpose: Stat labels, table headers, badges, meta/timestamp text.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default state for cards, tables, and list containers.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and time-blocks on hover, paired with translateY(-1px to -2px).

shadows.name: floating-fab
shadows.purpose: The floating add button, using a tinted indigo shadow instead of neutral black.

motion.name: press-down
motion.purpose: Universal tactile press feedback on every tappable element; scale amount tuned to control size.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition duration/easing for color, border, and background-color state changes.

motion.name: ease-hover-lift
motion.purpose: Hover translateY + shadow transitions on cards and time-blocks.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action pill button (e.g. 'Add block', 'Add application').
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #4338ca; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary/low-emphasis text button (e.g. 'Clear schedule', '+ Add item').
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #716b66; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 18px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #18181b; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: The primary tab navigation: a pill container holding icon+label tab buttons, active tab filled indigo.
components.css: .ds-tab-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; width: fit-content; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(24,24,27,0.05); } .ds-tab-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: none; padding: 9px 16px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #716b66; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tab-btn:hover { color: #18181b; } .ds-tab-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-tab-btn--active { background: #4f46e5; color: #fff; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card/container used across all tabs.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 10px; background: #ffffff; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(24,24,27,0.05); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field used in modals and inline editing.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid #e7e5e4; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Application status / category tag chip using a Secondary palette pair.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 10px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; background: #fef3c7; color: #b45309; }

components.name: Removable Chip
components.description: Meal/budget chip with an inline remove affordance.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: #e0e7ff; color: #4338ca; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 4px 4px 12px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip-x { background: none; border: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1; padding: 2px; }

components.name: Time Block
components.description: Signature component: an absolutely-positioned schedule-grid event card with a colored left border accent.
components.css: .ds-event { border-radius: 6px; padding: 5px 8px 5px 9px; font-family: Quicksand, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.3; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; border-left: 3px solid #7c3aed; background: #ede9fe; color: #6d28d9; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(24,24,27,0.06); transition: transform 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-event:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(24,24,27,0.14); } .ds-event-title { font-weight: 700; display: block; } .ds-event-meta { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.85; }

narrative.overview: Sanj's Planner reads like a well-kept paper planner, not a corporate dashboard: an ivory page, soft pastel tab colors for each life category, and one confident indigo used sparingly for anything actionable. It is a personal, single-user tool built to be glanced at dozens of times a day — on a phone between classes, on a laptop before a shift — so it stays calm, legible, and fast rather than expressive or decorative. There is no dark mode and no ambient/animated background: an earlier ambient sky-gradient and dark-mode concept was built and explicitly rejected as "not working," and the system settled on a single flat, warm, light theme instead. Every interactive element gives the same small, quiet confirmation on press — a slight scale-down — rather than a color flash or ripple.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, warm-neutral canvas (ivory page, white cards) with one saturated accent color used deliberately
A distinct soft-pastel color per life category (classes, shifts, meals, budget, applications) for at-a-glance scanning
Fully rounded pill shapes for anything tappable; softly rounded corners everywhere else
Near-flat elevation at rest; a real shadow appears only when something floats above the page
A single script wordmark ("Ephesis") reserved for the "Sanj's Planner" title only — everything else is Quicksand

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Confident Indigo appears only on things you can act on (buttons, active tab, links, FAB, focus rings). It never appears as a background tint or decoration — that restraint is what keeps it meaningful. This governs Indigo specifically; it does not restrict the Secondary/Tertiary category colors, which are meant to be used generously.

rules.name: The Category Owns Its Color Rule
rules.body: Once a UI element is about a specific category or status (a tab, a stat card, a status filter, a budget), it wears that category's own accent — never generic Indigo, never plain gray. A stat card's border tints to its own accent; a status filter's active state fills with that exact status's color; the active budget-switcher pill is Accent Budget, not Confident Indigo. Only truly generic, non-categorized actions (a primary Save button, the active tab pill itself, the FAB) get Confident Indigo. When adding a new category or status, give it a real accent and apply it to both its small chip and whatever container/pill represents it at rest. This extends to the page itself: a tab's own page background and its on-page muted text carry the color too, not just cards and chips.

rules.name: The One-Wordmark Rule
rules.body: Ephesis renders exactly once per screen — the page title. Every other heading, however large, stays in Quicksand at a heavier weight instead of switching typeface.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A visible shadow is a signal that something is temporarily above the page (a panel, a modal, a hovered card) — never a permanent decoration on static content.

rules.name: The Page Is Also a Category Rule
rules.body: Five of the six tabs are each a differently-tinted page, not a flat ivory canvas — like tabbed dividers in a physical binder — over a constant subtle dot-grid paper texture. Muted text sitting directly on a tab's wash tints toward that tab's own hue instead of staying gray; every floating surface (modals, popovers) resets back to neutral Warm Taupe on Paper White, since a popover is temporarily above the page, never part of it. Home stays untinted Warm Ivory since it is the overview, not one category.

dos: Do reserve Confident Indigo for actionable elements only (buttons, active tab, links, FAB, focus rings) — never as a decorative fill or background tint.
Do apply the universal press-down scale (transform: scale(0.93-0.98), ~150ms ease-out) to every new tappable element.
Do use the existing Secondary/Tertiary pastel pairs for any new category or status, rather than introducing a new hue.
Do keep shadows near-invisible on static content and reserve a visible shadow for anything that floats above the page.
Do tint secondary/muted text from the surface's own hue when it sits on a colored page background — never plain gray on a colored surface.
donts: Don't reintroduce an ambient gradient background, animated sky, or dark mode — both were built and explicitly rejected; the system is a single flat, warm, light theme by deliberate decision, not by omission. The per-tab page wash is a different device (a static, deliberate-palette tint per tab, not an atmospheric or animated gradient) and does not reopen that rejection.
Don't use the Ephesis script font anywhere except the single "Sanj's Planner" wordmark.
Don't add a border-and-shadow combination to a resting card — pick one (border for list/table containers, shadow-only for freestanding cards) rather than stacking both as a default.
Don't introduce a new framework, build step, or npm dependency to achieve a visual effect this system doesn't already support with plain CSS.
Don't use repeating-gradient stripes as surface texture or decoration — it reads as a generated-UI tell. Use a plain surface, a single (non-repeating) gradient, or a genuine dot/grid texture instead.
